choices.content: A right angle is larger than an acute angle
A right angle is smaller than an acute angle
A right angle and an acute angle are the same size

question.prompt: How does a right angle compare with an acute angle?

solutions.explanation: A right angle measures \(90^\circ\), while an acute angle measures less than \(90^\circ\). Therefore, a right angle is larger than an acute angle, so the answer is A.
solutions.title: Compare angle definitions
